NONE: › one of the electrodes (= objects that electricity moves through) in a piece of electrical equipment. The anode is the negative electrode in a battery and the positive electrode in an electrolytic cell.
正極，陽極

example: Compare
cathode

NONE: › to cover a metal with a layer of oxide by using an electric current
對…作陽極處理，對…作陽極氧化
› intended to avoid causing offence or disagreement, especially by not expressing strong feelings or opinions
（尤指透過不表達強烈的感情或意見而）不得罪人的，一團和氣的；溫和的

example: This is daytime television at its most anodyne.
這就是不痛不癢到了極點的日間電視節目。
Somehow this avoids being just another silly pop song with anodyne lyrics about love and happiness.
這首歌總算沒有淪為又一首愚蠢無聊的甚麼愛啊、幸福啊之類的流行歌曲。

T: › to make someone holy in a religious ceremony by putting holy water or oil on them
（在宗教儀式上）塗聖水（或聖油）於
› to make someone king or queen, especially as part of a religious ceremony
（尤指作為授予王位的宗教儀式的一部分）塗聖水（或聖油）於
› formal to choose someone to do a particular job, usually by a person in authority

example: [ + obj + noun ] In 751 Pepin was anointed king.
在751年，丕平被塗聖油，立為國王。
[ + as + noun ] It remains to be seen whom the chairman will anoint as his successor.
董事長將指定何人作為其接班人，還需拭目以待。

NONE: › a person or thing that is different from what is usual, or not in agreement with something else and therefore not satisfactory
異常的人（或事物）；不規則；（同一種類中的）畸形

example: Statistical anomalies can make it difficult to compare economic data from one year to the next.
統計上的不規範會使年與年之間的經濟數據難以互相比較。
The anomaly of the social security system is that you sometimes have more money without a job.
社會保障制度下的反常現像是，失業有時反而拿錢更多。

NONE: › a state of no moral or social principles in a person or in society
（個人或社會的）道德淪喪
› soon or in the near future
不久以後，未幾
› abbreviation for anonymous (= a writer whose name is not known), usually written at the end of a piece of writing
匿名，不具名（通常標在一篇文章末尾）（anonymous的縮寫）

example: See you anon.
再會。

NONE: › the situation in which someone's name is not given or known
匿名；無名；不公開姓名

example: The police have reassured witnesses that they will be guaranteed anonymity.
警方讓目擊證人放心，保證不公開他們的姓名。

NONE: › to remove any information that shows which particular person something relates to
匿名化，無名化處理

example: We anonymize the data so researchers cannot identify any individual subjects.
我們將資料做匿名化處理，這樣研究人員就無法辨認單個的實驗物件。
anonymized medical records
經匿名化處理的病歷

NONE: C2 made or done by someone whose name is not known or not made public
匿名的；不知姓名的；名字不公開的
› having no unusual or interesting features
無特色的，無個性特徵的

example: The money was donated by an anonymous benefactor.
這筆錢來自一位不願透露姓名的捐贈者。
Police said an anonymous caller warned that a bomb was about to go off.
警方說有人打來匿名電話，警告一枚炸彈即將爆炸。
An attempt to implant an embryo using an egg from an anonymous woman donor was unsuccessful.
用一位匿名女性捐贈的卵子來植入胚胎的嘗試未獲成功。
He received an anonymous letter threatening to disclose details of his affair if he didn't pay the money.
他收到一封匿名信，威脅說如果他不付錢，就把他的風流韻事都抖出來。
For reasons of personal safety, the informant wishes to remain anonymous.
為了自身安全，舉報人不希望透露姓名。
He has a rather anonymous face.
他相貌平平。

NONE: › a type of mosquito (= a small flying insect), especially one that spreads malaria to humans
（尤指傳播瘧疾的）瘧蚊；按蚊

C: › mainly UK US usually parka a short coat that protects the wearer against wind, rain, and cold weather, usually with a part for covering the head
（通常指帶有風帽的）防寒短上衣，短風雨衣
› UK disapproving a boring person who is too interested in the details of a hobby and finds it difficult to meet and spend time with other people
（對一些無關緊要的細節著迷的）難相處的傢夥，有怪癖的人

example: There are enough facts and figures in this book to keep even the most obsessive anorak fascinated for hours.
這本書內容翔實，數據豐富，就連那些最熱衷於鑽牛角尖的讀者也會沉迷其中，數小時不能釋手。

NONE: › a serious mental illness in which a person does not eat, or eats too little, often resulting in dangerous weight loss
（尤指女性由於害怕變胖而引起的）厭食（症）；食慾缺乏

example: Reports of anorexia and other eating disorders are on the increase.
患厭食症以及其他飲食紊亂症的病例不斷上升。
Compare
bulimia

NONE: › suffering from or relating to anorexia
食慾減退的，厭食的
› a person who suffers from anorexia
患厭食症的人，厭食者

example: She looks anorexic to me.
我看她好像缺乏食慾。
Anorexics tend to be obsessional and perfectionist.
厭食症患者往往有強迫症，且是完美主義者。

NONE: A2 one more person or thing or an extra amount
又一的，再一個的
› a lot of things, one after the other
一個接一個，接連
A2 a different person or thing
不同的（人或事物）；別的；另一
B1 each other
互相，彼此
› in some way that is not known yet
用某種方法，想方設法

example: I'm going to have another piece of cake.
我要再吃塊蛋糕。
"Would you get me a bar of chocolate from the kitchen?" "Another one?"
「從廚房給我拿塊巧克力好嗎？」「你還要？！」
We can fit another person in my car.
我車裡還可以再坐一個人。
Danny's had yet another car accident.
丹尼又出交通意外了。
For another £30 (= for £30 more) you can buy the model with a touchscreen.
再加30英鎊，你就可以買觸控式螢幕的那種型號了。
Just think, in another three months (= three months from now) it'll be summer again.
想想吧，再過三個月就又到夏天了。
I'm not surprised he's feeling ill - he was eating one ice cream after another!
他生病我不覺得奇怪——他不停嘴地吃霜淇淋！
Do you want to exchange this toaster for another (one) or do you want your money back?
你是想另換一台烤麵包機，還是要退貨？
They gave one another presents when they met at the airport.
他們在機場見面時互贈了禮物。
We'll get out of this mess one way or another.
我們得想個甚麼辦法擺脫這種困境。

NONE: › UK another opportunity to do something
做…的第二次機會

example: He missed a medal in the 100 metres, but will get a second bite of the cherry in the 400 metres.
他失去了100米賽跑的金牌，不過在400米賽跑中仍有機會。

NONE: › an event that causes the failure of something that had already started to fail
導致失敗的事件，致命打擊，催命符

example: Each successive revelation of incompetence is another nail in the chairman's coffin.
接二連三地顯露出不稱職是導致董事長下臺的一道道催命符。
That report drove the final nail in the company's coffin.
那份報告為公司敲響了喪鐘。
